segments.name: Air Mobility
segments.description: Operates scheduled regional flights sold per seat and subsidized Essential Air Service routes, plus an on-demand charter marketplace for passengers.
segments.evidence: The Company and its chief operating decision maker ("CODM"), which is the Company's chief executive officer , organize and manage the Company on a consolidated basis, and, accordingly, the Company operates as a single operating and reportable segment, namely its Air Mobility segment.

revenueModel.text: Passengers pay per seat for scheduled flights and for on-demand charter flights, while the Department of Transportation pays EAS subsidy awards for completed flights.
revenueModel.evidence: Scheduled Air Service - revenue from operating scheduled commercial air service flights which are sold to the public primarily on a per seat basis, and through subsidized EAS revenue awards from the Department of Transportation.
